claims.claim: Falkland Islands residents have been angered by Argentine visitors waving Argentine flags and banners denying British sovereignty, prompting calls to restrict such visits.
claims.episode_span: Residents of the Falkland Islands have been angered by Argentine visitors waving Argentine flags
claims.source_title: Falklands weighs curbs on Argentine visitors after flag-waving incidents
claims.supporting_quote: Falkland Islands residents have been angered by Argentine visitors seen waving Argentine flags and banners denying British sovereignty, prompting calls from members of the community to restrict such visits.

claims.claim: Argentine nationals can currently enter the Falkland Islands with a valid passport, proof of return travel, confirmed accommodation, health insurance and sufficient funds.
claims.episode_span: Argentine nationals can currently enter with a valid passport, proof of return travel
claims.source_title: Falklands weighs curbs on Argentine visitors after flag-waving incidents
claims.supporting_quote: Argentine nationals can currently enter the Islands with a valid passport, proof of return travel, confirmed accommodation, health insurance and sufficient funds.

claims.claim: MLA Michael Goss said he is not personally opposed to restrictions but that people cannot be directly stopped from coming in at this moment because of legal limits.
claims.episode_span: we can’t turn around and directly stop people coming in at this moment in time
claims.source_title: Falklands weighs curbs on Argentine visitors after flag-waving incidents
claims.supporting_quote: He said he is personally not opposed to restrictions, but that the matter ultimately comes down to what can be done legally. “So we can’t turn around and directly stop people coming in at this moment in time,” he said.

claims.claim: Goss said the Assembly has begun examining options to stop political-agenda visits, that such visits are not acceptable, and that Argentine noise including at the UN will not shake the islands.
claims.episode_span: people “visiting the Falkland Islands” to further a political agenda is “not acceptable.”
claims.source_title: Falklands weighs curbs on Argentine visitors after flag-waving incidents
claims.supporting_quote: “We have got to make sure that we’re not going to be seeing more and more incidents of people who are, quote unquote, ‘visiting the Falkland Islands’ to further a political agenda — it’s not acceptable.”

claims.claim: The incidents have recurred as President Javier Milei’s government has stepped up Argentina’s sovereignty claim, including legal action against companies exploring for oil near the Islands.
claims.episode_span: including legal action against companies exploring for oil near the Islands
claims.source_title: Falklands weighs curbs on Argentine visitors after flag-waving incidents
claims.supporting_quote: They have recurred as President Javier Milei’s government has stepped up Argentina’s sovereignty claim, including legal action against companies exploring for oil near the Islands.

claims.claim: The Hotesur and Los Sauces trial against Cristina and Máximo Kirchner is heading toward reunification, is expected to begin within three weeks, and the Federal Chamber of Cassation would define rejoining the cases after a hearing on 15 October.
claims.episode_span: The Federal Chamber of Cassation would define reuniting the two cases after a hearing set for 15 October.
claims.source_title: El juicio Hotesur y Los Sauces contra Cristina y Máximo Kirchner se encamina a su reunificación
claims.supporting_quote: Está previsto que el proceso comience dentro de tres semanas; la Cámara Federal de Casación definiría volver a unir ambas causas tras una audiencia que realizará el 15 de octubre

claims.claim: With 100 percent of ballot boxes counted, Maranhão voters chose 18 federal deputies and 42 state deputies on Sunday.
claims.episode_span: voters in Maranhão on Sunday chose 18 federal deputies and 42 members of the state legislative assembly
claims.source_title: Veja quem são os deputados federais eleitos no Maranhão
claims.supporting_quote: Com 100% das urnas apuradas, os eleitores no Maranhão (MA) escolheram neste domingo (4) 18 deputados federais.

claims.claim: In Bahia, Rui Costa (PT) and Jaques Wagner (PT) were elected to the Senate, and 39 federal deputies were elected.
claims.episode_span: Rui Costa of the Workers’ Party and Jaques Wagner of the Workers’ Party were elected to the Senate
claims.source_title: Conheça os senadores eleitos na Bahia
claims.supporting_quote: Na Bahia (BA), os eleitos para o Senado são Rui Costa (PT) e Jaques Wagner (PT).

claims.claim: In Amazonas, voters chose 24 state deputies, and Eduardo Braga (MDB) and Plinio Valério (PSDB) were elected senators.
claims.episode_span: Eduardo Braga of the MDB and Plinio Valério of the PSDB were elected senators
claims.source_title: Veja os senadores eleitos no Amazonas
claims.supporting_quote: Eduardo Braga (MDB) e Plinio Valério (PSDB) foram eleitos senadores pelo Amazonas (AM).

claims.claim: Flávio Bolsonaro won around 47 percent of valid votes and Lula about 45 percent, so they face a runoff on 25 October, according to the Superior Electoral Court count reported by MercoPress.
claims.episode_span: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro took around 47 percent of valid votes and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva about 45 percent
claims.source_title: Flávio Bolsonaro edges Lula in the first round; both head to an October 25 runoff
claims.supporting_quote: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro won around 47% of valid votes in the first round of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday, ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who took about 45%, according to the Superior Electoral Court's count.

claims.claim: Argentina’s National Meteorological Service issued yellow alerts on 5 October for storms in Formosa and Misiones, with 20 to 50 millimetres of rain possible, and for 20 to 40 centimetres of snow in Andean San Juan, Neuquén and Mendoza.
claims.episode_span: yellow alerts for Monday for storms in Formosa and Misiones, with 20 to 50 millimetres of rain possible
claims.source_title: Hay alerta amarilla por tormentas y nevadas para este lunes 5 de octubre: las provincias afectadas
claims.supporting_quote: Según el organismo nacional, la alerta amarilla por tormentas rige en las provincias de Formosa y Misiones.
